# PicEte — Free Online Image Tools

> All-in-one online image processing. Convert, resize, and compress images entirely in your browser. No uploads, no servers, no sign-ups.

## Core Tools

- **PNG ↔ JPG** — https://picete.com/png-to-jpg/ | https://picete.com/jpg-to-png/
- **WebP ↔ PNG** — https://picete.com/webp-to-png/ | https://picete.com/png-to-webp/
- **JPG → WebP** — https://picete.com/jpg-to-webp/
- **Image Resizer** — https://picete.com/resize-image/
- **Image Compressor** — https://picete.com/compress-image/

## Key Facts

- All processing: client-side Canvas API only
- Images never uploaded to any server
- Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP
- Quality range: 10-100
- Hosted on Vercel
- Canonical: https://picete.com
